entries.titleJa: 賛成3vs反対3のLLMディベートで「陣営内均質化」を確かめた
entries.titleEn: An experiment pitting three pro-LLM agents against three con-LLM agents…
entries.summaryJa: 固定陣営型のLLMディベートを検証した結果、役割ラベルだけでは発言が同一内容に収束する「stance homogenization」が生じ、多様な意見を引き出すには各役に個別の利害を与える必要があることが示された。
entries.summaryEn: An experiment pitting three pro-LLM agents against three con-LLM agents revealed that role labels alone cause intra-side stance homogenization; genuine diversity requires assigning distinct individual stakes to each agent.
entries.contentSnippet: TL;DR 「賛成派3人・反対派3人・判定役1人」という固定陣営型のディベートを1つのチャットに演じさせ、個人の意思決定（週末副業を引き受けるか）に使えるか検証した 同じ陣営に複数の役を立てても、役に「守るもの（個別の利害）」を与えない限り、同じ陣営内の発言はほぼ同一内容に収束する。これは学術的にも「stance homogenization」として報告されている既知の傾向と一致した 役割ラベル単体（「あなたは賛成派です」）は出力分布をわずかにシフトさせるだけで、対立や多様性を保証しない。対立を生んでいるのは陣営ラベルではなく、各役に割り当てた個別の利害

entries.contentSnippet: Imagine this scenario: Your team decides to migrate a core application from an existing commercial database like Oracle or SQL Server to open source PostgreSQL or a fully managed service such as AlloyDB for PostgreSQL . The initial phase goes smoothly. Schemas convert, tables populate, and data migration pipelines transfer terabytes of data in hours. The project looks ahead of schedule. Then your team hits the bottleneck. Buried inside the existing databases are hundreds of stored procedures, complex triggers, and custom functions written in proprietary SQL dialects like PL/SQL or T-SQL. entries.summaryEn: Looker's governed semantic layer now integrates with Gemini Enterprise, providing structured context to LLMs so employees get consistent, trustworthy answers when querying enterprise data through natural language.
entries.contentSnippet: For organizations deploying AI agents at scale, there’s often a critical divide between structured and unstructured data. While large language models (LLMs) excel at parsing text documents, emails, and PDFs, they can struggle when presented with raw enterprise databases. Meanwhile, standard natural-language-to-SQL (NL2SQL) models often guess how database schemas fit together, which can lead to unpredictable queries, inconsistent metrics, and AI hallucinations that erode user trust. Gemini Enterprise brings the best of Google AI to every employee through an intuitive chat interface that acts as a single front door for AI in the workplace. And now, Looker’s governed semantic layer serves as the trusted foundation for structured data within Gemini Enterprise, enabling trusted self-service bus

Whether it’s using a mobile app to order a product, contact customer service, view content, or manage their account, the customer experience depends on how well an app can run locally on the customer’s device. However, procuring and hosting devices at scale is expensive and complex, and tests are often flaky, inconclusive, or just difficult to debug. This leaves many developers to test launches on the physical phones in their pockets and hope the results apply to most devices. entries.contentSnippet: In today’s agentic era, modern cloud applications are evolving from a set of passive tools to fleets of autonomous digital workers that reason, plan, and take action across a wide range of tasks. But as those workloads move into production and scale to support additional users or use cases, teams quickly hit a critical challenge: AI agents tend to operate in bursts; for a while they actively process requests or execute code, followed by long periods of inactivity while awaiting user input or external triggers. entries.summaryJa: HuaweiのACRLは、LLMのRL学習でFSDP/vLLM間の精度差（BF16 vs FP8）による実質的なoff-policy化を適応的に補正し、トークン単位の勾配重み調整でBF16基線を上回る精度をわずか0.1%のオーバーヘッドで実現する。
entries.summaryEn: Huawei's ACRL framework monitors the discrepancy between training (FSDP/Megatron) and inference (vLLM/SGLang) engines caused by FP8 vs BF16 precision gaps, then adjusts per-token gradient weights to prevent training collapse while outperforming BF16 baselines across 3B–32B Dense and MoE models.
entries.contentSnippet: TL;DR LLMの強化学習（RL）では、訓練エンジン（FSDP/Megatron）と推論エンジン（vLLM/SGLang）が異なる実装と精度（BF16 vs FP8）を使うため、on-policyのはずの学習が実質off-policyになる。この訓練-推論乖離は学習崩壊を引き起こす。Huaweiが提案したACRLは、乖離度を適応的に監視し、トークンごとの勾配重みを調整することで、FP8量子化下でもBF16基線を上回る精度を達成する。計算オーバーヘッドはわずか0.1%。GRPO/PPO/DAPOの3アルゴリズム、3B〜32Bの4モデル、Dense/MoE

entries.contentSnippet: なぜ今「MCP」と「A2A」を混同したまま使ってはいけないのか! 最近、社内のDX推進の場でも「MCP対応しました」「A2Aで連携します」という言葉をよく聞くようになった。ただ、実際に話を聞いてみると、この2つがかなり曖昧に、時には同じ意味であるかのように使われているケースが多い。 結論から言うと、この2つは全く別のレイヤーの話をしている。MCPは「AIエージェントが道具をどう使うか」の規格で、A2Aは「AIエージェント同士がどうやり取りするか」の規格だ。似ているようで、守備範囲がまったく違う。 この記事では、この違いを人間の組織に置き換えて直感的に理解

entries.title: Knowledge Graphs Meet Graph Neural Networks: A Comprehensive Survey
entries.titleJa: 知識グラフとグラフニューラルネットワークの融合：包括的サーベイ
entries.titleEn: Knowledge Graphs Meet Graph Neural Networks: A Comprehensive Survey
entries.summaryJa: 知識グラフとGNNを組み合わせた研究領域を体系的に整理し、知識グラフ補完・推論・質問応答などへの応用を網羅的に調査した論文。両技術の相互強化の可能性と今後の課題を明示している。
entries.summaryEn: This survey systematically reviews how knowledge graphs and graph neural networks reinforce each other across tasks like KG completion, reasoning, and QA, offering a unified taxonomy and highlighting open research challenges.
entries.contentSnippet: arXiv:2607.09666v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have emerged as a powerful paradigm in Knowledge Graphs (KGs) due to their intrinsic ability to model graph-structured data. entries.title: AuditWeave: A Tamper-Evident, Auditor-Navigable Evidence Layer for AI-Assisted and Data-Transformation Workflows
entries.titleJa: AuditWeave: AIアシストおよびデータ変換ワークフロー向けの改ざん防止・監査者対応エビデンス層
entries.titleEn: AuditWeave: A Tamper-Evident, Auditor-Navigable Evidence Layer for AI-Assisted and Data-Transformation Workflows
entries.summaryJa: AuditWeaveは、AIや데이터변환パイプラインにおける処理履歴を暗号的に保護し、監査者が追跡・検証しやすい証跡層を提供するフレームワークである。規制対応やモデルの説明責任が求められる場面での透明性確保に貢献する。
entries.summaryEn: AuditWeave proposes a tamper-evident evidence layer that cryptographically secures processing histories in AI-assisted and data-transformation pipelines, making them navigable for auditors. This addresses growing demands for accountability and regulatory compliance in automated workflows.
entries.contentSnippet: arXiv:2607.09682v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: AI systems are increasingly used to assist consequential decisions in regulated domains such as auditing, finance, and healthcare. entries.title: MawForge: Memory-Bounded Expert Materialization for Local Mixture-of-Experts Inference
entries.titleJa: MawForge: ローカル環境でのMixture-of-Experts推論向けメモリ制約エキスパート実体化
entries.titleEn: MawForge: Memory-Bounded Expert Materialization for Local Mixture-of-Experts Inference
entries.summaryJa: MawForgeは、限られたメモリ環境でMoEモデルをローカル推論する際に、使用頻度の高いエキスパートを事前に実体化してキャッシュする手法を提案する。これによりメモリ効率を維持しながら推論速度を大幅に改善できる。
entries.summaryEn: MawForge proposes a memory-bounded strategy for local Mixture-of-Experts inference by selectively materializing frequently activated experts within a fixed memory budget, enabling faster inference on consumer hardware without sacrificing model quality.
entries.contentSnippet: arXiv:2607.09686v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models separate total parameter count from per-token active computation, but local inference systems often still require the full model, key-value cache, runtime buffers, and operatingsystem

entries.title: What Context Does a Coding Agent Actually Need to Act?
entries.titleJa: コーディングエージェントが行動するために実際に必要なコンテキストとは？
entries.titleEn: What Context Does a Coding Agent Actually Need to Act?
entries.summaryJa: 本研究は、コーディングエージェントが効果的にタスクを遂行するために必要なコンテキストの種類と量を体系的に分析し、不要な情報を削減して性能を維持できる条件を明らかにした。
entries.summaryEn: This paper systematically investigates which types and amounts of context are truly necessary for coding agents to act effectively, revealing that many agents can maintain performance with significantly reduced input context.
entries.contentSnippet: arXiv:2607.09691v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A modern coding agent can hold an entire repository in its context window. entries.title: Reference-Based Distillation Detection in LLMs
entries.titleJa: LLMにおける参照ベースの蒸留検出
entries.titleEn: Reference-Based Distillation Detection in LLMs
entries.summaryJa: 大規模言語モデルが他のモデルから知識蒸留されているかを参照モデルを用いて検出する手法を提案。モデルの知的財産保護やサプライチェーンの透明性確保に貢献する。
entries.summaryEn: This paper proposes a reference-based method to detect whether an LLM has been trained via knowledge distillation from another model, enabling protection of model intellectual property and improving AI supply-chain transparency.
entries.contentSnippet: arXiv:2607.09692v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Model distillation -- training on outputs from stronger third-party models -- is widely used to boost performance, but raises concerns about unfair advantages and policy violations. This motivates a fundamental question: can we dete

entries.title: Depth-Entropy Guided Sampling for Training-Free LLM Reasoning
entries.titleJa: 訓練不要なLLM推論のための深度エントロピー誘導サンプリング
entries.titleEn: Depth-Entropy Guided Sampling for Training-Free LLM Reasoning
entries.summaryJa: 各トークン生成時にTransformerの層ごとのエントロピーを活用してサンプリングを動的に調整する手法を提案し、追加学習なしに推論精度を向上させる。計算コストを抑えながら複雑な推論タスクの性能を高められる点が重要。
entries.summaryEn: This paper proposes a training-free sampling method that uses per-layer entropy signals from Transformer depth to guide token generation, improving LLM reasoning without any fine-tuning. It offers a practical way to boost performance on complex reasoning benchmarks at low additional cost.
entries.contentSnippet: arXiv:2607.09693v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become the dominant paradigm for improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models, but it requires expensive training, curated data, and reward signals. entries.title: Low-Rank Attention Residuals
entries.titleJa: 低ランク注意残差（Low-Rank Attention Residuals）
entries.titleEn: Low-Rank Attention Residuals
entries.summaryJa: Transformerのアテンション層における残差接続を低ランク近似で置き換える手法を提案し、モデルの表現力を保ちながらパラメータ効率を大幅に改善できることを示した研究。
entries.summaryEn: This paper proposes approximating attention residuals with low-rank structures in Transformers, showing that model expressiveness can be maintained while significantly reducing parameter counts and improving efficiency.
entries.contentSnippet: arXiv:2607.09694v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Attention Residuals replace the fixed residual sum with depthwise attention over previous sub-layer outputs in large language models (LLMs), but use each output as both a full-dimensional key and value. entries.title: Safe responses matter: Output-aware safety guardrail mitigate over-refusal in MLLMs
entries.titleJa: 安全な応答が重要：MLLMsにおける過剰拒否を軽減する出力認識型セーフティガードレール
entries.titleEn: Safe responses matter: Output-aware safety guardrail mitigate over-refusal in MLLMs
entries.summaryJa: マルチモーダル大規模言語モデルが安全なリクエストまで拒否しすぎる「過剰拒否」問題に対し、出力内容を考慮したガードレール手法を提案。有害コンテンツを防ぎつつ正当な要求への応答精度を向上させる。
entries.summaryEn: This paper proposes an output-aware safety guardrail for multimodal LLMs that reduces over-refusal by evaluating the model's generated response, not just the input. This improves usability without compromising safety.
entries.contentSnippet: arXiv:2607.09697v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Existing safety mechanisms for multimodal large language models (MLLMs) face a fundamental trade-off between safety and utility. Model fine-tuning achieves robust safety but compromises general utility. Input-side safety guardrails

entries.title: EvoClawBench: Can Agents Learn Reusable Skills from Their Own Runs?
entries.titleJa: EvoClawBench: エージェントは自身の実行履歴から再利用可能なスキルを学習できるか？
entries.titleEn: EvoClawBench: Can Agents Learn Reusable Skills from Their Own Runs?
entries.summaryJa: EvoClawBenchは、AIエージェントが過去の実行経験からスキルを抽出・再利用できるかを評価する新ベンチマークで、汎化能力の研究を促進する。
entries.summaryEn: EvoClawBench introduces a benchmark for evaluating whether AI agents can extract and reuse skills from their own prior runs, advancing research into agent generalization and continual learning.
entries.contentSnippet: arXiv:2607.09711v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Existing agent benchmarks primarily test task completion, tool use, or skill utility, but do not isolate whether a runtime can convert evidence from its own runs into reusable skills that improve fresh executions after authoring ove

entries.titleJa: 符号分岐繰り返しペナルティにおけるゲージ依存性と構造化出力の破損：モデル・推論スタック・代替制御手法にわたる測定
entries.titleEn: Gauge dependence and structured-output corruption in sign-branched repetition penalties: measurements across models, inference stacks, and alternative repetition controls

entries.summaryEn: This paper demonstrates that sign-branched repetition penalty implementations introduce gauge dependence that corrupts structured outputs such as JSON across multiple models and inference stacks, and evaluates alternative repetition control strategies to mitigate the problem.
entries.contentSnippet: arXiv:2607.09791v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The multiplicative repetition penalty shipped across the LLM inference ecosystem (HuggingFace, vLLM, llama.cpp, and a dozen further engines) branches on the sign of each raw logit (divide positives by theta, multiply negatives). entries.title: Format Sensitivity Index: Token-Controlled Prompt Wrapper Robustness and Schema Compliance in LLM Benchmarking
entries.titleJa: Format Sensitivity Index：トークン制御プロンプトラッパーの堅牢性とLLMベンチマークにおけるスキーマ準拠
entries.titleEn: Format Sensitivity Index: Token-Controlled Prompt Wrapper Robustness and Schema Compliance in LLM Benchmarking
entries.summaryJa: LLMがプロンプトの書式変更に対してどれだけ出力を安定させられるかを定量化する「Format Sensitivity Index」を提案し、ベンチマーク評価の信頼性向上に貢献する研究。
entries.summaryEn: This paper introduces the Format Sensitivity Index, a metric that quantifies how much LLM outputs shift under token-level prompt wrapper variations, highlighting reliability gaps in current benchmarking practices.
entries.contentSnippet: arXiv:2607.09665v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Prompt wrappers often differ only in formatting, yet they can change model scores enough to flip leaderboard conclusions. entries.title: Faithful, Not Corrective: Message-Format Effects in Multi-Hop Agent Relays Are Tier-Dependent
entries.titleJa: 忠実であって修正はしない：マルチホップエージェントリレーにおけるメッセージ形式の影響はティアに依存する
entries.titleEn: Faithful, Not Corrective: Message-Format Effects in Multi-Hop Agent Relays Are Tier-Dependent
entries.summaryJa: マルチホップエージェントリレーでは、メッセージの形式が下流エージェントの動作に与える影響がエージェントの階層によって異なり、上流エージェントは誤りを修正せず忠実に伝達することが示された。複数エージェント系の設計における信頼性評価に重要な知見を提供する。
entries.summaryEn: This study finds that message-format effects in multi-hop agent relay chains are tier-dependent: agents faithfully propagate upstream content rather than correcting errors, with implications for reliability in multi-agent system design.
entries.contentSnippet: arXiv:2607.09678v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: When LLM agents hand off information to one another, does the message format matter? entries.title: Interpreting Latent CoT Reasoning as Dynamical Systems
entries.titleJa: 潜在的CoT推論を動的システムとして解釈する
entries.titleEn: Interpreting Latent CoT Reasoning as Dynamical Systems
entries.summaryJa: 本研究はLLMの潜在空間におけるChain-of-Thought推論を動的システムの観点から分析し、推論過程の内部構造を数理的に解明する手法を提案する。推論メカニズムの解釈可能性向上に貢献する。
entries.summaryEn: This paper proposes a dynamical-systems framework for analyzing latent Chain-of-Thought reasoning in LLMs, offering a principled mathematical lens to understand how intermediate reasoning steps evolve in hidden states. It advances interpretability of complex multi-step reasoning.
entries.contentSnippet: arXiv:2607.09698v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent latent reasoning methods, such as CODI and COCONUT, face a fundamental interpretability problem: they maintain multiple superimposed candidate traces in the hidden space at each step, unlike explicit- CoT, which follows a sin

entries.title: YUKTI: From Natural-Language Situations to Robust, Verifiable Decisions An Uncertainty-Typed Proposition IR, Assumption-Robust Pareto Frontiers, and a Regret Certificate
entries.titleJa: YUKTI: 自然言語の状況から堅牢で検証可能な意思決定へ――不確実性型命題IR・仮定ロバストパレートフロンティア・後悔証明書
entries.titleEn: YUKTI: From Natural-Language Situations to Robust, Verifiable Decisions An Uncertainty-Typed Proposition IR, Assumption-Robust Pareto Frontiers, and a Regret Certificate
entries.summaryJa: YUKTIは自然言語で記述された意思決定状況を不確実性型命題の中間表現に変換し、仮定に対してロバストなパレートフロンティアと後悔証明書を生成することで、検証可能な意思決定を実現するフレームワークである。曖昧な前提を明示的に扱える点が実用上の重要な貢献となっている。
entries.summaryEn: YUKTI is a framework that converts natural-language decision scenarios into an uncertainty-typed proposition IR, then derives assumption-robust Pareto frontiers and regret certificates to produce verifiable, auditable decisions. It advances AI decision-making by explicitly handling ambiguous assumptions rather than ignoring them.

entries.title: AfterVibe: What Remains When the Conversation Ends
entries.titleJa: AfterVibe: 会話が終わった後に何が残るか
entries.titleEn: AfterVibe: What Remains When the Conversation Ends
entries.summaryJa: 本研究はAIとの対話終了後にユーザーの感情や認知にどのような影響が持続するかを分析し、チャットシステム設計における「余韻」の重要性を示した。
entries.summaryEn: This paper examines the emotional and cognitive residues that persist after human-AI conversations end, highlighting design implications for conversational systems that account for post-interaction effects.
entries.contentSnippet: arXiv:2607.09900v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present AfterVibe, a framework that recovers natural-language specifications from a vibe coding session. Given a code artifact and the conversation trajectory that produced it, AfterVibe uses an LLM to extract an abstract natural

entries.title: Do These Violent Delights Have Violent Ends? Measuring the Post-Merge Fate of Agentic Code
entries.titleJa: AIエージェントが書いたコードはマージ後どうなるか？その追跡調査
entries.titleEn: Do These Violent Delights Have Violent Ends? Measuring the Post-Merge Fate of Agentic Code
entries.summaryJa: 本論文はAIエージェントが生成しマージされたコードのその後の運命を実証的に調査し、品質や保守性への長期的影響を定量化した研究である。エージェント生成コードの実用上のリスクを把握する上で重要な知見を提供する。
entries.summaryEn: This paper empirically tracks the post-merge lifecycle of code produced by AI coding agents, measuring its long-term quality, churn, and maintenance burden compared to human-written code. The findings inform real-world risk assessments of deploying agentic coding systems.
entries.contentSnippet: arXiv:2607.09902v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Agentic coding tools are increasingly used to make autonomous repository-level changes to real-world projects. entries.title: Using LLMs to Adjudicate Static-Analysis Alerts with Error Reduction Techniques
entries.titleJa: LLMを用いた静的解析アラートの判定とエラー低減技術
entries.titleEn: Using LLMs to Adjudicate Static-Analysis Alerts with Error Reduction Techniques
entries.summaryJa: 本論文は、静的解析ツールが生成する大量の誤検知アラートをLLMで自動判定し、エラー低減技術を組み合わせることで精度を高める手法を提案している。開発者の負担軽減とセキュリティ品質向上に貢献する研究成果である。
entries.summaryEn: This paper proposes using LLMs to automatically triage static-analysis alerts—distinguishing true bugs from false positives—while applying error reduction techniques to improve adjudication accuracy and reduce developer burden.
entries.contentSnippet: arXiv:2607.09979v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Static analysis is widely used for finding security weaknesses in source code before deployment, but it often produces far more alerts than analysts can review. We study how well large language models (LLMs) can adjudicate (classify

entries.title: Consensus vs. Dissent: Dynamic LLM Modeling of Subjective Preferences in Group Recommenders
entries.titleJa: 合意と反対意見：グループ推薦における主観的嗜好の動的LLMモデリング
entries.titleEn: Consensus vs. Dissent: Dynamic LLM Modeling of Subjective Preferences in Group Recommenders
entries.summaryJa: 本研究はグループ推薦システムにおいて、LLMを用いてメンバー間の合意と反対意見を動的にモデル化する手法を提案する。個人の主観的嗜好を柔軟に捉えることで、グループ全体の満足度向上を目指す。
entries.summaryEn: This paper proposes a dynamic LLM-based framework for group recommender systems that models both consensus and dissent among members' subjective preferences, improving collective satisfaction beyond simple preference aggregation.

entries.summaryEn: Index SLM introduces a series of small language models designed to achieve competitive performance at reduced parameter counts, enabling practical deployment in edge and on-device scenarios.

entries.summaryEn: RouteRec introduces a rigorous benchmark for evaluating how recommender agents are selected and aggregated, enabling systematic measurement of routing strategies across multiple agents.

entries.summaryEn: This paper applies large language models to predict deal outcomes in merger-arbitrage investing, showing that NLP signals from financial text meaningfully improve forecasting accuracy across global markets.

entries.summaryEn: This paper proposes methods to evaluate and improve the factual faithfulness of LLM-generated clinical trial summaries tailored to diverse audiences, including patients and clinicians. It addresses a critical safety concern by reducing hallucinations in high-stakes medical communication.

entries.summaryJa: Google DeepMindは分散学習手法DiLoCoを拡張した「DDiLoCo」を発表。通信と同期を切り離し、ノード障害や帯域制約下でも大規模モデルの学習を継続でき、より柔軟で耐障害性の高い分散訓練を実現する。
entries.summaryEn: Google DeepMind unveiled Decoupled DiLoCo (DDiLoCo), which separates communication from synchronization so large-scale model training continues despite node failures or limited bandwidth, enabling flexible, resilient distributed AI training.

image.alt: Decoupled DiLoCo: A new frontier for resilient, distributed AI training

entries.title: Partnering with industry leaders to accelerate AI transformation
entries.titleJa: Google DeepMind、業界リーダーとの提携でAI変革を加速

entries.summaryEn: Google DeepMind has announced expanded partnerships with industry-leading companies to accelerate enterprise AI transformation, centering on the deployment of Gemini models across key sectors.
entries.contentSnippet: Google DeepMind partners with global consultancies to bring the power of frontier AI to organizations around the world.

image.alt: Partnering with industry leaders to accelerate AI transformation

entries.title: Introducing Claude Design by Anthropic Labs

entries.title: Introducing Anthropic’s Claude Opus 4.7 model in Amazon Bedrock

entries.title: Scaling Managed Agents: Decoupling the brain from the hands
entries.titleJa: Anthropicが解説するManaged Agentsの設計思想
entries.titleEn: Scaling Managed Agents: Decoupling the brain from the hands
entries.summaryJa: Anthropicは、Claudeを基盤とする「Managed Agents」の設計指針を公開した。エージェントを管理する側の視点から、信頼境界、権限委譲、観測性、長時間実行ジョブの扱いなど、本番運用で重要となる要素を整理している。
entries.summaryEn: Harnesses encode assumptions that go stale as models improve. Managed Agents-our hosted service for long-horizon agent work-is built around interfaces that stay stable as harnesses change.
entries.contentSnippet: Harnesses encode assumptions that go stale as models improve. Managed Agents-our hosted service for long-horizon agent work-is built around interfaces that stay stable as harnesses change.

entries.titleEn: Bugbot Learned Rules and MCP Support

entries.summaryEn: This release introduces updates to Bugbot including the ability to self-improve in real time, MCP support, improvements to Bugbot Autofix, and the highest resolution rate to date.
entries.contentSnippet: This release introduces updates to Bugbot including the ability to self-improve in real time, MCP support, improvements to Bugbot Autofix, and the highest resolution rate to date.

entries.titleEn: An initiative to secure the world's software | Project Glasswing
entries.summaryJa: AnthropicはProject Glasswingを発表し、AIを活用してソフトウェアの脆弱性を大規模に発見・修正する取り組みを開始した。攻撃側に対する防御側の優位確立を狙い、世界中のソフトウェアセキュリティ強化を目指す。
entries.summaryEn: Anthropic announced Project Glasswing, an initiative using AI to discover and fix software vulnerabilities at scale. It aims to give defenders the advantage over attackers and strengthen security across the world's software.

entries.title: When AIs act emotional
entries.titleJa: AIが感情的に振る舞うとき:Anthropicが探るモデルの情動表現
entries.titleEn: When AIs act emotional
entries.summaryJa: Anthropicが公開した動画で、AIモデルが感情的な反応を示す現象を議論。研究者は情動表現がユーザー体験や安全性に及ぼす影響を解説し、感情的な振る舞いをどう解釈し扱うべきかについて見解を示している。
entries.summaryEn: Anthropic discusses why AI models sometimes act emotional, exploring how affective expression shapes user experience and safety, and how researchers interpret and handle such behavior.

entries.title: Long-running Agents in Research Preview
entries.titleJa: Cursor、長時間稼働エージェントをResearch Previewで公開
entries.titleEn: Long-running Agents in Research Preview
entries.summaryJa: Cursorはクラウド上で長時間稼働する自律型エージェント機能をResearch Previewとして公開した。複数のタスクを並列で実行し、開発者の介入なしに長期的な作業を継続できる点が特徴で、AIコーディング支援の新たな段階を示す。
entries.summaryEn: Cursor can now work autonomously over longer horizons to complete larger, more complex tasks. Long-running agents plan first and finish more difficult work without human intervention.
entries.contentSnippet: Cursor can now work autonomously over longer horizons to complete larger, more complex tasks. Long-running agents plan first and finish more difficult work without human intervention.

entries.title: Introducing Claude Opus 4.6
entries.titleJa: Anthropic、フラッグシップモデルClaude Opus 4.6を発表
entries.titleEn: Introducing Claude Opus 4.6
entries.summaryJa: Anthropicが最上位モデルClaude Opus 4.6を発表。コーディングやエージェント用途を中心に性能を強化し、前世代から推論力と実用性を改善した最新フラッグシップとして位置付けられる。
entries.summaryEn: Anthropic announced Claude Opus 4.6, its new flagship model with improved coding and agentic performance, positioned as the top-tier offering with stronger reasoning and practical capabilities over the prior generation.

entries.title: Claude on Mars
entries.titleJa: Claude on Mars: Anthropic公開のYouTubeショート動画
entries.titleEn: Claude on Mars
entries.summaryJa: Anthropicが公式YouTubeチャンネルで短尺動画『Claude on Mars』を公開した。AIアシスタントClaudeのブランドイメージや想像力豊かな利用シーンを訴求する広報コンテンツとみられる。
entries.summaryEn: Anthropic released a short-form video titled 'Claude on Mars' on its official YouTube channel. It appears to be promotional content highlighting Claude's brand image and imaginative use cases rather than a product announcement.

entries.title: Your tools are now interactive in Claude
entries.titleJa: Claudeのツールがインタラクティブに、UI操作が可能に
entries.titleEn: Your tools are now interactive in Claude
entries.summaryJa: Anthropicは、Claude内のツールがインタラクティブに動作するようになったと発表した。ユーザーはチャット内でボタンやフォームを直接操作でき、テキスト応答に頼らずUIを通じた双方向のやり取りが可能になる。
entries.summaryEn: Anthropic announced that tools in Claude are now interactive, letting users click buttons and fill forms directly in chat instead of relying on text-only responses for a richer, hands-on experience.

entries.title: Subagents, Skills, and Image Generation
entries.titleJa: Cursor 2.4、サブエージェント・Skills・画像生成を追加
entries.titleEn: Subagents, Skills, and Image Generation
entries.summaryJa: Cursor 2.4は、メインエージェントが複数タスクを並列分担するサブエージェント、再利用可能な手順を定義するSkills、画像生成を追加。長時間タスクの自動化と文脈管理を強化する。
entries.summaryEn: Cursor 2.4 introduces subagents that let the main agent delegate tasks in parallel, reusable Skills for defining workflows, and image generation, improving context management for complex, long-running tasks.
entries.contentSnippet: Agents are solving increasingly complex, long-running tasks across your codebase. This release introduces new agent harness improvements for better context management, as well as many quality-of-life fixes in the editor and CLI.

entries.title: AI on campus
entries.titleJa: Anthropic動画『AI on campus』:大学キャンパスでのClaude活用
entries.titleEn: AI on campus
entries.summaryJa: Anthropicの動画『AI on campus』は、Claudeなどのai​ツールが大学の教育や研究、学生の学習にどう浸透しているかを紹介。教員と学生双方の視点から、課題やキャンパス運営への影響を伝える内容となっている。
entries.summaryEn: Anthropic's video 'AI on campus' shows how Claude and other AI tools are spreading across universities, exploring impacts on teaching, research, and student learning from both faculty and student perspectives.

entries.title: Introducing Cowork: Claude Code for the rest of your work
entries.titleJa: Anthropic、業務全般向け新ツール「Cowork」を発表
entries.titleEn: Introducing Cowork: Claude Code for the rest of your work
entries.summaryJa: Anthropicが、開発者向けClaude Codeのエージェント体験をエンジニアリング以外の一般業務へ拡張する新ツール「Cowork」を発表した。調査や文書作成など幅広いタスクをAIに委任でき、業務自動化の新たな選択肢となる。
entries.summaryEn: Anthropic unveiled Cowork, bringing the Claude Code agent experience to non-engineering work so teams can delegate broad tasks to AI, expanding agentic automation well beyond coding.

entries.title: AI's limited self-knowledge
entries.titleJa: AIの限定的な自己認識:Anthropicが示す内省の限界
entries.titleEn: AI's limited self-knowledge
entries.summaryJa: Anthropicの短編動画が、AIモデルは自身の内部処理を正確には把握できず、自己説明が実際の挙動と乖離しうると指摘。解釈可能性研究の重要性を改めて強調する内容。
entries.summaryEn: An Anthropic short explains that AI models have limited ability to introspect on their own internal states, so their self-reports may diverge from actual processing, underscoring why interpretability research matters.

entries.title: DORA 2025: Year in review
entries.titleJa: DORA 2025年の振り返り：AI時代の開発生産性研究の進化
entries.titleEn: DORA 2025: Year in review
entries.summaryJa: GoogleのDORAチームが2025年の活動を総括。AI支援開発に関する大規模調査「State of AI-assisted Software Development Report」の公開や、AI導入を成熟させるためのDORA AI Capabilities Modelの提示など、研究の重心がAI時代の開発生産性へとシフトしたことを報告している。
entries.summaryEn: A look back at the highlights and community contributions from 2025.
entries.contentSnippet: A look back at the highlights and community contributions from 2025.

entries.title: Announcing OpenAI Grove Cohort 2
entries.titleJa: OpenAI Grove コホート2 発表
entries.titleEn: Announcing OpenAI Grove Cohort 2
entries.summaryJa: OpenAIはスタートアップ支援プログラム「Grove」の第2期コホートを発表した。新興AIスタートアップへの支援拡大が目的で、エコシステム強化につながる。
entries.summaryEn: OpenAI announced the second cohort of its Grove startup program, expanding support for emerging AI companies and strengthening its broader developer ecosystem.
entries.contentSnippet: Applications are now open for OpenAI Grove Cohort 2, a 5-week founder program designed for individuals at any stage, from pre-idea to product. Participants receive $50K in API credits, early access to AI tools, and hands-on mentorship from the OpenAI team.

entries.title: A history of DORA’s software delivery metrics
entries.titleJa: DORAソフトウェアデリバリ指標の歴史と進化
entries.titleEn: A history of DORA’s software delivery metrics
entries.summaryJa: DORAが10年以上にわたり研究してきたソフトウェアデリバリ指標の変遷を振り返る記事。デプロイ頻度やリードタイムなど4つの主要指標の成立経緯と、信頼性指標の追加など近年の改訂を解説している。
entries.summaryEn: DORA’s software delivery performance metrics have evolved over time to reflect the changing technology landscape. Learn about the transition from the four keys to the current five-metric model.
entries.contentSnippet: DORA’s software delivery performance metrics have evolved over time to reflect the changing technology landscape. Learn about the transition from the four keys to the current five-metric model.

entries.title: What is sycophancy in AI models?
entries.titleJa: AIモデルにおけるシコファンシー(おもねり)とは何か
entries.titleEn: What is sycophancy in AI models?
entries.summaryJa: AIモデルがユーザーに過度に同調・迎合する「シコファンシー」現象を解説。RLHFなどの学習過程でなぜ生じるのか、誤りを肯定してしまう問題点を示し、信頼できるAI構築への課題を提示する。
entries.summaryEn: Anthropic explains sycophancy in AI models—the tendency to overly agree with or flatter users—covering how it emerges from training like RLHF and why it undermines efforts to build trustworthy, reliable AI.

entries.title: Let Claude handle work in your browser
entries.titleJa: Claudeにブラウザ作業を任せる新機能
entries.titleEn: Let Claude handle work in your browser
entries.summaryJa: Anthropicが、Claudeにブラウザ操作を委ねる新機能を発表。ユーザーに代わりウェブサイトを閲覧・操作し、調査やフォーム入力などのオンライン業務を自動化する、AIエージェント実用化を進める一手だ。
entries.summaryEn: Anthropic introduces a feature that lets Claude browse and operate websites on your behalf, automating research, form-filling, and other online tasks—advancing practical AI agents directly in the browser.

entries.title: Claude ran a business in our office
entries.titleJa: Anthropic、Claudeに自販機事業を運営させる実験を公開
entries.titleEn: Claude ran a business in our office
entries.summaryJa: AnthropicはAIエージェントClaudeに社内の小型店舗運営を任せる実験「Project Vend」を実施。在庫管理や価格設定、顧客対応を自律的に行わせ、AIによる長期的な経済活動の可能性と限界を検証した。
entries.summaryEn: Anthropic ran Project Vend, letting Claude autonomously operate a small office store and handle inventory, pricing, and customer service, testing both the promise and pitfalls of AI managing long-term economic tasks.

entries.title: Binti helps social workers license foster families faster with Claude
entries.titleJa: Binti、Claudeで里親認定業務を高速化し児童福祉を支援
entries.titleEn: Binti helps social workers license foster families faster with Claude
entries.summaryJa: 児童福祉ソフトを提供するBintiは、ソーシャルワーカーが里親家庭を迅速に認定できるようClaudeを活用。書類処理や評価作業の効率化により、子どもたちが安全な家庭に早く迎えられる体制を整えている。
entries.summaryEn: Binti, a child welfare software provider, uses Claude to help social workers license foster families faster by streamlining paperwork and assessments, so children can reach safe homes more quickly.

entries.title: What does AI mean for education?
entries.titleJa: AIは教育に何をもたらすのか:Anthropicが示す展望
entries.titleEn: What does AI mean for education?
entries.summaryJa: Anthropicが教育におけるAIの役割を議論する動画を公開。学習のパーソナライズや教師の役割変化、批判的思考力の育成など、AI時代の教育機関が直面する課題と機会を整理している。
entries.summaryEn: Anthropic's video explores how AI is reshaping education, covering personalized learning, evolving teacher roles, and fostering critical thinking, while mapping the challenges and opportunities schools now face.

entries.title: What does it take to be an AI whisperer?
entries.titleJa: AnthropicがYouTube Shortsで語る「AIウィスパラー」の条件
entries.titleEn: What does it take to be an AI whisperer?
entries.summaryJa: AnthropicがYouTube Shortsで、AIを巧みに使いこなす「AIウィスパラー」に必要な資質を解説。プロンプト設計や対話スキルがAI活用の鍵となる点を短く伝えている。
entries.summaryEn: Anthropic's YouTube Short explores what it takes to be an AI whisperer, highlighting that strong prompting and conversational skills are key to getting the most out of AI tools.

entries.title: AI as a tutor
entries.titleJa: AIを家庭教師として活用する開発組織の学習スタイル
entries.titleEn: AI as a tutor
entries.summaryJa: DORAの調査によると、AIを単なるコード生成器ではなく家庭教師のように使い概念や設計の理解を深める開発者は、生産性や学習効果が高い傾向にある。組織はこの使い方を促す文化と仕組みを整えるべきだと指摘している。
entries.summaryEn: DORA research finds developers who use AI as a tutor to deepen understanding of concepts and design outperform those treating it as a mere code generator, urging organizations to foster this learning practice.
entries.contentSnippet: While critics worry students use AI to cheat, our research reveals something different: students are using AI to learn. At UC Berkeley, many students in technical fields are using AI to teach them rather than do for them: AI was a supplement to the role of professor, TA, or tutor

entries.title: Announcing the initial People-First AI Fund grantees
entries.titleJa: People-First AI Fund の最初の助成先を発表
entries.titleEn: Announcing the initial People-First AI Fund grantees
entries.summaryJa: OpenAIはPeople-First AI Fundの初回助成先団体を公式発表し、AIの恩恵を広く社会に届けることを目指す取り組みを本格始動させた。
entries.summaryEn: OpenAI announced the first cohort of grantees for its People-First AI Fund, marking the program's official launch to direct AI benefits toward underserved communities.
entries.contentSnippet: The OpenAI Foundation announces the initial recipients of the People-First AI Fund, awarding $40.5M in unrestricted grants to 208 nonprofits supporting community innovation and opportunity.
